channel.title: IRONSCALES incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from IRONSCALES's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Incidents' page is not loading [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been fully resolved. No impact on processing, analysis, or remediation of the emails was encountered during this incident. IRONSCALES is updating its internal procedures to prevent similar issues in the future.

item.title: UAE region is experiencing issues due to AWS infrastructure downtime [resolved]
Intermittent Issues with the Investigation Page in US-Hosted Environments [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the Investigation tab in US-hosted IRONSCALES environments has been fully resolved. A partial data gap of approximately 2.5 hours occurred during the disruption period. Core email protection services, including inspection and mitigation, remained fully operational and unaffected throughout the incident. System functionality is now stable, and no further impact is expected.
